title: 🏆 Underwrld Tiers · Waitlists
description:
Pick a gamemode below to **join** its waitlist and unlock the dedicated queue channel.
Pick the same gamemode again to leave that waitlist.

fields.name: 🔒 Requirements
fields.value:
You must be **Verified** first — head to the verify channel if you haven't.
Hit **🍀 My Cooldowns** to check remaining time across every gamemode.
Hit **🚫 Remove Waitlist** to pick a specific waitlist role to drop.
:octagonal_sign: **Failure to provide authentic information will result in a denied test.**
